asof_cutoff_rule: Phase 13S features are pre-game knowable: current_starter / confirmed_* are derived from PREVIOUS game's min (lagged); starter_proxy_lagged uses 10-game lagged minutes; team-aggregate composition features are computed from teammates whose previous game's min >= 1 (pre-game knowable expected-to-play set); injury / availability / vacated-opportunity features are joined as-of from the upstream live_context parquet.
